exposure: Pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH) with congenital heart disease (CHD)
Eisenmenger syndrome (ES) vs. residual PAH after CHD repair
cohort: Eight patients with PAH-CHD who conceived pregnancy between 2013 and 2021
finding: Pregnancy and delivery in women with PAH-CHD carries a high risk for maternal complications and should be avoided, even with advanced treatment and multidisciplinary care.
mod_finding: Three ES patients delivered preterm by Caesarean section under general anaesthesia.
